thread:
emma: Quick sync: we need a faster way for engineers to trace automatic fallback events from console -> logs -> request. Current flow is too many clicks.

ryan: Agree. In last incident we had to grep multiple indexes. We need a single stable key.

liam: Proposal: emit a small trace token in three places: console table, response header (dev-only flag), and telemetry. Token format = rwfb:<decision_id>.<short-hash>.

zara: UX note: console should show token and a tiny chevron that expands to the human reason. Keep row density high.

emma: Also need to record trigger_type (eg TIMEOUT, MODEL_OOM, RATE_LIMIT, TRACED_EXCEPTION) as a tag, not free text. Makes filtering possible.

ryan: Privacy: we must never put any user prompt or PII in headers. Headers should be opt-in for internal accounts only.

telemetry-bot: :warning: rollout-plan: header-flag = "rw.fallback.headers" gated to internal orgs for 2 weeks. Full telemetry always flows to event-store.

liam: Implementation detail: decision_id must be idempotent across retries. Suggest hashing (trace_id || policy_version || minute_bucket) => base62(8).

zara: Console action: add "view event" button that opens /events?token=rwfb:... and pre-filters. No modal full-blob inline; link to eventstore for rich JSON.

emma: Sampling: don't ship every fallback to UI. Add sampling_rate_in_ui field. UI shows sampled examples, but eventstore retains full stream. Sampling also needs reason: we prefer tail-sampling of errors.

ryan: Tests: e2e should assert header present when flag ON and that header is absent for external API keys. Also check sampled vs all telemetry persisted.

liam: For analytics, add a compact proto schema: decision_id, policy, policy_version, trigger_type, from_variant, to_variant, sampling_hint, elapsed_ms. Keep payload small.

zara: Concern: customers running private deployments may want different retention. Add Settings > Audit retention per-org.

emma: I'll sketch a tiny RFC with header example and console mock. Will include example header: `X-Rw-Fallback: rwfb:abc12345.policy=soft-fail.v3.trigger=TIMEOUT.to=redwood-lite`

ryan: Nice. One more ask: expose an operator-only column that shows recent operator overrides (who, why, ttl). Can be collapsed by default.

telemetry-bot: :information_source: note: metrics emitted -> counter.fallbacks_by_trigger, histogram.fallback_latency_ms; new tags: policy_version, decision_id.

emma: I'll post RFC + link to staging flag tomorrow. Tagging @eng-sre and @eng-ml for model transition hooks.

liam: Thanks all. Small follow-up: let's centralize decision_id generation in runtime to avoid drift.

zara: ACK. I'll update console JIRA with mockups.
